scope: Independent static review of the two exact diagnostic candidate blobs; no code execution, new benchmark or native qualification.

findings.evidence: Both inserted call sites and the sequence_tests module are cfg(all(test, unix)); ordinary non-test service and Windows paths contain no new call. The existing Instant import was already used.

The original exchange arguments, result match/reject behavior, two rounds, bootstrap/connection/record budgets, deadline values and final assertion record_validation_attempts==2 remain unchanged. The assertion adds numeric observation diagnostics only.

The enabled helper prints only round, connection count, elapsed nanoseconds, optional response length and Failure::cell's fixed class/ErrorKind/errno. It does not format raw CellError, replies, SQL messages, endpoints, provider records or signing keys. report.discovery Debug has only six count fields.

limitations: Every Unix test exchange pays Instant/env-read overhead even when the diagnostic environment value is not exactly1.
When enabled, synchronous stderr I/O occurs after exchange and before received_at/wall samples; it can perturb scheduling, remaining deadlines and time observations.
There is no independent hard timeout for the stderr write. An outer job deadline is not proof of identical original timing.
The diagnostic package-selected feature graph and instrumented source cannot establish original full-workspace or performance qualification.
No Cargo, compiler, original fixture or native execution was performed in this review.
verdict: No confirmed new blocking defect in the narrow static diagnostic delta; preserve diagnostic-only/HOLD qualification boundary.
